newsitem.title: JAPAN: Russia Almaz officials in Tokyo for PGM talks.
newsitem.headline: Russia Almaz officials in Tokyo for PGM talks.

text.p: Senior officials from Russia's platinum group metal exporter Almazjuvelirexport (Almaz) arrived in Tokyo over the weekend to hold talks with Japanese customers on their 1997 export contracts.
The officials' presence in Tokyo was confirmed by the hotel at which they are staying.
The Russian officials, Vitaly Berlin and Andrei Travkin, checked into a hotel in central Tokyo on Sunday.
"They checked into our hotel yesterday, and reserved rooms until June 7," a manager of the hotel told Reuters.
They are expected to hold talks with Japanese trading houses and bullion houses on 1997 export contracts for the metals throughout this week, local traders said.

Bureaucratic delays in Russia have prevented any export licences for PGMs from being issued so far this year, resulting in a protracted suspension of Russian PGM exports since the beginning of this year.
This led to a surge in palladium prices to 17-year highs.
Japan is the world's largest PGM consumer. Russia supplies more than 60 percent of the world's palladium and about 20 percent of its platinum.
